title: OceanLight: Efficient Global Ocean Forecasting via Geometry-Adaptive Unstructured Mesh Representation
abstract: arXiv:2608.16070v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Reliable global ocean forecasting is critical for climate monitoring, marine navigation, and extreme event early warning. Physics-based ocean forecasting models impose prohibitive computational costs, while existing deep learning approaches predominantly rely on structured-grid architectures, incurring unnecessary computation on masked land cells and enforcing uniform resolution across dynamically heterogeneous ocean regions regardless of local flow complexity. Here we present OceanLight, an efficient global ocean forecasting framework innovatively combining geometry-adaptive unstructured mesh tokenization with a graph neural network (GNN) backbone. translated_title: 海洋之光：基于几何自适应非结构化网格表示的高效全球海洋预报
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.16070v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：可靠的全球海洋预报对于气候监测、海洋导航和极端事件预警至关重要。基于物理的海洋预报模型带来高昂的计算成本，而现有的深度学习方法主要依赖结构化网格架构，在掩蔽的陆地上产生不必要的计算，并对动态异质的海洋区域强制采用统一分辨率，而不考虑局部流动复杂性。在此，我们提出海洋之光（OceanLight），一个高效全球海洋预报框架，创新性地将几何自适应非结构化网格标记化与图神经网络（GNN）主干相结合。海洋之光实现了逐点预报精度和动能谱保真度，超越运营数值分析和最先进的基于AI的模型，同时在地转平衡一致性上超越所有基于AI的海洋模型。此外，海洋之光展示了可靠的性能。
tldr: 海洋之光通过几何自适应非结构化网格与图神经网络结合，实现了高效、高精度的全球海洋预报，超越了现有AI模型和数值分析，尤其在地转平衡一致性上表现卓越。
en_tdlr: OceanLight integrates geometry-adaptive unstructured mesh with GNNs to achieve efficient, high-accuracy global ocean forecasting, surpassing existing AI models and numerical analyses, particularly in geostrophic balance consistency.
